target: >=95% P0/P1 scenario coverage and zero flaky P0 tests

defects.title: Contact cap could be exceeded by parallel creates
Seat cap could be exceeded by parallel invites
Tag and flow caps could be exceeded by parallel creates
Parallel sign-ups for one e-mail made several accounts
Every other capped create had the same unlocked count-then-insert; fixed through one helper (residual in CC-LIM-19)
Coupon last uses could be handed out twice; fixed with a deliberate deviation from Reference, coupons owner to confirm
Contact edited to an e-mail another contact holds: Reference allows it on edit

scenarios.scenario: 3 agents claim one conversation
scenarios.invariant: One wins, others 409, one event

scenarios.scenario: Same e-mail signing up x6
scenarios.invariant: One account, others 409

scenarios.scenario: One reset link used x5
scenarios.invariant: One winner, only its password works

scenarios.scenario: 12 wrong passwords at once
scenarios.invariant: Only 401/423/429, never 5xx

scenarios.scenario: Contact create x10 same e-mail/phone
scenarios.invariant: One contact, every caller gets it

scenarios.scenario: One paid order finalised x8
scenarios.invariant: Counts one use

scenarios.scenario: 12 orders finalised at once
scenarios.invariant: 12 uses, no lost increment

scenarios.scenario: Last coupon uses raced by 8 buyers at checkout
scenarios.invariant: Orders holding a use never exceed max_uses; a failed order gives its use back
scenarios.notes: D-06 fixed. Deliberate deviation from Reference (enforces the advertised limit under concurrency); coupons owner to confirm.

scenarios.scenario: Two contacts edited to one e-mail
scenarios.invariant: No 5xx, rows readable (weak: sequential edit allows it, D-07)

scenarios.scenario: Edit and delete of one contact
scenarios.invariant: No 5xx, not half of each

scenarios.scenario: Same new tag attached x8
scenarios.invariant: One tag, one link

scenarios.scenario: Tag name x8 in parallel
scenarios.invariant: One 201, seven 409, one row

scenarios.scenario: Same Idempotency-Key x10 in parallel
scenarios.invariant: One row, replies are the same 201 or 409, never 5xx

scenarios.scenario: Same key, different bodies in parallel
scenarios.invariant: One body runs, the rest 409, one row

scenarios.scenario: Redis outage while an idempotent request runs
scenarios.invariant: Fails closed, nothing created
scenarios.notes: Not tested: cannot stop the shared Redis.

scenarios.scenario: 10 invoices issued at once
scenarios.invariant: Distinct gap-free numbers

scenarios.scenario: One invoice issued x6
scenarios.invariant: Issued once, one number used

scenarios.scenario: 6 payments on a 200.00 invoice
scenarios.invariant: Never more than the total recorded

scenarios.scenario: Same message queued x10 (same and distinct job ids)
scenarios.invariant: Stored once

scenarios.scenario: 60 messages, parallel consumers
scenarios.invariant: Each stored once, gap-free seq

scenarios.scenario: Stalled job recovery after a worker crash
scenarios.invariant: No lost, no double job
scenarios.notes: Not tested: needs killing a worker process.

scenarios.scenario: Contacts cap, 12 parallel creates
scenarios.invariant: Never more rows than the cap

scenarios.scenario: Seat cap, 8 parallel invites
scenarios.invariant: Never more users than the cap

scenarios.scenario: Tags cap, 10 parallel creates
scenarios.invariant: Never more rows than the cap

scenarios.scenario: Devices cap and one number x5
scenarios.invariant: Cap holds, one number is one device

scenarios.scenario: Flows cap, 8 parallel creates
scenarios.invariant: Never more rows than the cap

scenarios.scenario: Capped creates fixed by the shared lock but without their own parallel test: templates, recurring invoices, catalog products, SMS senders, custom fields (fields endpoint), broadcasts, scheduled messages, campaigns, appointments, saved-reply import
scenarios.invariant: Never more rows than the cap
scenarios.notes: D-05 fixed in code (same lock); parallel test not written: needs a gateway, a connected sender or a worker to create one row.

scenarios.scenario: Contact import with the contact cap in parallel
scenarios.invariant: Cap holds for bulk imports
scenarios.notes: Not tested: needs the import worker flow.

scenarios.scenario: Hand-rolled caps not behind the shared lock: tags auto-created by the contact resolver and the form submit, invoices_monthly from a store order
scenarios.invariant: Never more rows than the cap
scenarios.notes: D-05 residual, open (Low): these skip rather than refuse, or run outside a transaction.

scenarios.scenario: Contact: 8 writers, same row_version
scenarios.invariant: Exactly one update wins, 7 get 409 ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT, no lost update

scenarios.scenario: Company: 8 writers, same row_version
scenarios.invariant: Same as above on a second entity

scenarios.scenario: Outbound send with one clientMessageId x6
scenarios.invariant: One message, one provider call

scenarios.scenario: Inbound: same provider id x20, 16 and 50 messages from a new sender
scenarios.invariant: One message, one thread, gap-free seq

scenarios.scenario: Three drainers, 700 events
scenarios.invariant: Each handled once, none left

scenarios.scenario: Subscriber fails for some events
scenarios.invariant: Failed rows kept for retry, others once

scenarios.scenario: Drainers in separate processes and nodes
scenarios.invariant: Same as OBX-01 across nodes
scenarios.notes: Not tested: needs several nodes; one process was used (the SQL claim is the same).

scenarios.scenario: Referral reward triggered x8
scenarios.invariant: Paid once

scenarios.scenario: Referral code issuing in parallel
scenarios.invariant: One code per user, codes unique

scenarios.scenario: Round robin, 12 customers at once x5 rounds
scenarios.invariant: Even split, each routed once, rule counter exact

scenarios.scenario: One refresh token x6 (double click)
scenarios.invariant: All succeed, session alive, one rotation, one session

scenarios.scenario: Replay of a token two rotations old, parallel
scenarios.invariant: All refused, session revoked

scenarios.scenario: 8 sign-ins with a cap of 2
scenarios.invariant: At most 2 live sessions

scenarios.scenario: Storage counters, 20 uploads at once
scenarios.invariant: Counters add up, a key counts once, reservations settle
scenarios.notes: Observe mode only; refusal is not built.

scenarios.scenario: Storage quota refusal under parallel uploads
scenarios.invariant: Quota refuses over-cap uploads
scenarios.notes: Not testable: enforce mode (phase S2) is not built.

scenarios.scenario: Two organizations writing and reading at once
scenarios.invariant: No cross-tenant rows, cross reads 404

scenarios.scenario: Tenant context leaking between pooled connections under load
scenarios.invariant: No leak

scenarios.scenario: 12 strict debits on a small balance
scenarios.invariant: Only what fits succeeds, 409 for the rest, no negative balance

scenarios.scenario: Same top-up key x10
scenarios.invariant: Credited once

scenarios.scenario: Top-ups and debits interleaved
scenarios.invariant: Balance equals ledger sum, never below zero

scenarios.scenario: Delivery receipts: one message id x10, then 10 messages
scenarios.invariant: Charged once per id, never overdrawn

scenarios.scenario: Payment webhook delivered twice plus return page
scenarios.invariant: Wallet credited once

scenarios.scenario: Channel provider webhooks replayed in parallel (Meta, Telegram...)
scenarios.invariant: One stored message per provider id
scenarios.notes: Covered at the ingest layer by CC-MSG-02; the HTTP signature layer per channel is not tested.
